dedup_key.description: Stable key for 'same suggestion'; unique across all items in any status

body.description: Operator-facing rationale + evidence (dates, merchants, amounts, item ids); must stand alone — the operator may never open the prompt

value.description: Expected usefulness to the operator; see AGENTS.md anchors

deadline.description: Perishability; past deadline the item is set to expired

prompt.description: Self-contained prompt for an executor agent session; embeds its own evidence and never refers back to the body

source.description: What produced the item — a playbook name (e.g. plaid_anomalies) or a short tag for a self-directed finding

rejection_reason.description: Why the operator rejected it; feeds future calibration

snoozed_until.description: When you set status=snoozed (e.g. from a clicked snooze action), the date to revisit

actions.description: Operator-facing buttons you attach to the item. The dashboard renders each as a click/un-click toggle; the click state is recorded by the console under clicks/<item-id>/<action-id> (NOT here). You reduce clicked actions on your next run — interpret the label/intent, do it, then clear the click. Include whatever fits: standard ones (snooze/reject/done) are just commands you interpret, plus item-specific ones.

id.description: Stable id within the item (used in the click path)

label.description: Button text shown to the operator

kind.description: A request you execute next run when clicked (toggle)

intent.description: A self-contained instruction you (or a handed-off executor) carry out when this is clicked

id.description: Stable id within the item (used in the click path)

label.description: Button text shown to the operator

kind.description: A claude.ai/new deep-link rendered inline (no click state)

prompt.description: The prepared prompt to hand to Claude via the deep-link
